(lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb:62-65) nor load_locale (lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb:46-60) normalizes locale before checking @loaded_locales.include?(locale) (lines 48, 64) or appending @loaded_locales << locale (line 58). Because :en != 'en' in Ruby, passing the same locale as both a Symbol and a String bypasses the include? check, triggers a redundant load of the locale's YAML files, and appends a duplicate entry to @loaded_locales.
